description: UA-CrossBorder-Flows: an open hourly dataset and day-ahead export-forecast pipeline for the cross-border electricity flows of the IPS of Ukraine (to PL, SK, RO, MD), published by Titov, Vladyslav, combines Ukrainian physical export flows, prices and weather with a day-ahead forecasting pipeline. Coverage: Ukrainian exports toward Poland, Slovakia, Romania and Moldova, with 29,762 hourly rows in 2022-2025. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: The author reports low day-ahead predictability and an R-squared near 0.12. This is not a validated digital twin despite a suggested monitoring use. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
